author: PostOakLabs
description: Authoring side of the ocg-document-span@1 sidecar profile: drop a CSV or JSON file, click the value you used, and name the tool input it feeds; the page extracts the lexical with the pinned RFC 4180 parser or an RFC 6901 walk, runs the four reference checks in-browser against the embedded published kernel digest list, and exports the batch as a spans file to attach at verify time. No Policy Mandate export: the page evaluates no policy, rule, mandate, routing or risk decision; its only output is span evidence. Client-side. Works offline. Zero PII.

current_value.description: Optional current value at the input pointer, as JSON text or a plain string; supplying it enables the step-4 canonical-digest binding

document_text.description: The full text of the CSV or JSON document the span binds against

locator.description: Where the value sat: scheme csv-rfc4180-cell with record, column and header, or scheme json-pointer with pointer

normalization.description: One of the closed four: string-exact, decimal-plain, integer-plain, date-iso

pointer.description: RFC 6901 pointer naming the input in policy_parameters, for example /cash_balance

row_key.description: Optional CSV row guard: column and value pinning the record; a repeated value is refused as ambiguous

source_ref.description: Bare file name of the document, no path separators

mcp_tool_definition.description: Builds and checks ocg-document-span@1 span records binding one input value to one location in one supplied CSV or JSON document: document sha256, RFC 4180 cell or RFC 6901 pointer locator, byte-exact lexical, declared normalization, and the canonical-digest binding against a supplied current value. Refuses rather than guesses and returns records, per-record reports and refused entries. Checks supplied text only; not financial advice. Client-side only, zero PII.

current_value.description: Optional current value at the input pointer, JSON text or plain string; enables the step-4 binding

document_text.description: The full text of the CSV or JSON document

locator.description: csv-rfc4180-cell (record, column, header, optional row_key) or json-pointer (pointer)

pointer.description: RFC 6901 pointer naming the input in policy_parameters

row_key.description: Optional CSV row guard: column and value

source_ref.description: Bare file name of the document

mcp_tool_definition.name: run_tieout_workbench

records.description: The ocg-document-span@1 records that passed authoring, one per input spec

refused.description: Authoring-side refusals with spec_index, reason_code and detail; never became records

reports.description: Per-record four-step reports: pointer, type, profile, structural, verifiable, reason_code, detail
